title: An Input-Dependent Readout Phase for Resonant Sequence Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.12496v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Sequence models with a fixed-size state avoid the quadratic cost of attention, but face a design choice. An input-dependent state transition gives content-dependent memory at the cost of FFT-based training, while a fixed transition keeps the O(T log T) convolutional path but reads memory the same way for every input. ResonatorLM, a recent model of the second kind, reads a bank of damped complex oscillators through a fixed learned phase per head. We make that readout phase a function of the current token, which adds input dependence to the read only, keeps the convolution exact, and costs 0.2 percent more parameters. An analysis of the untrained bank shows that phase does encode elapsed time, but an ordinary token falls below the background within 2-8 steps and no choice of damping extends linear reconstruction beyond about 16 tokens. translated_title: 谐振序列模型的输入依赖读取相位
translated_abstract: 具有固定大小状态的序列模型避免了注意力机制的二次方计算开销，但面临一个设计选择：输入依赖的状态转移能提供内容相关的记忆，但代价是需要基于FFT的训练；而固定转移则保留了 O(T log T) 的卷积路径，却对每个输入都以相同方式读取记忆。ResonatorLM 是最近提出的属于第二类的模型，它通过每个注意力头固定的学习相位来读取一组阻尼复振荡器。我们将该读取相位改为当前 token 的函数，从而仅在读取过程中引入输入依赖性，同时保持卷积的精确性，且仅增加 0.2% 的参数。对未训练振荡器组的分析表明，相位确实编码了经过的时间，但普通 token 会在 2-8 步内衰减到背景水平以下，且任何阻尼选择都无法将线性重建扩展到约 16 个 token 之外。在 WikiText-2 上使用 600 万参数的字符级模型实验中，输入依赖相位与原模型在（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文将 ResonatorLM 中每个头固定的读取相位改为当前 token 的函数，仅在读取环节引入输入依赖性，在保持精确卷积和仅增加 0.2% 参数的同时提升了模型能力，并分析了未训练振荡器组的相位可编码时间但线性重建能力受限（约 16 个 token）。
en_tdlr: This paper makes ResonatorLM's fixed per-head readout phase a function of the current token, adding input dependence only at read time while keeping the convolution exact and adding just 0.2% more parameters, and further analyzes that untrained oscillator phases encode elapsed time but linear reconstruction is limited to about 16 tokens.
